contentList.content: Quick Resolve

[Non-legit while enabled]

Instantly settle select long-winded quests. Pick an outcome, the scene plays out off-screen, and the journal, experience and rewards are granted as if you had played it through.
Quick Resolve: Save Arabella
Instantly conclude the Snake Court in the Emerald Grove. Choose Arabella's fate, the scene plays out off-screen, and the journal, experience and reward are granted as if you had talked it through.
Quick Resolve: Arcane Tower

Settle the Arcane Tower without making the climb. The power comes back on, Bernard is talked down and stays friendly, and the Timmask spore, the Tongue of Madness and the Guiding Light ring move out of the tower and into your bags.

Ancient Mega Pack

Settle the Arcane Tower now? The power returns, Bernard is talked down for good, and his ring along with Omeluum's ingredients move from the tower into your bags.

Ancient Mega Pack

The tower can no longer be talked down. Bernard is dead, roused or already dealt with, or Omeluum has no further use for the ingredients.
Quick Resolve: Stop the Presses
Instantly publish the flattering article in the Baldur's Mouth, skipping the printing house sneaking. The city reads the good word about you the moment the ink dries.
Quick Resolve: Murder Tribunal
Instantly settle the Murder Tribunal. Free Valeria peacefully or cut Sarevok down, and the way to the murderers' sanctum is revealed either way.
Quick Resolve: The Devil's Fee
Skip Helsik's scavenger list. The ritual ingredients appear in your bags and the portal to the House of Hope opens on its own.
Quick Resolve: Find Dribbles the Clown
Call off the hunt for the clown's scattered remains. The journal completes, and the experience and reward are granted as if you had pieced him together yourself.

Ancient Mega Pack

Resolve the Snake Court without playing the scene. Intervene and save Arabella?

Ancient Mega Pack

Leave Arabella to the serpent's judgement? She will not survive it.

Ancient Mega Pack

The Snake Court has already concluded. There is nothing left to resolve.

Ancient Mega Pack

Publish the flattering article in the Baldur's Mouth right now? The break-in, the press and the waiting are all skipped.

Ancient Mega Pack

Resolve the Murder Tribunal peacefully? Valeria goes free and reveals the way to the murderers' sanctum.

Ancient Mega Pack

Strike Sarevok down instead? The tribunal falls, and the way to the murderers' sanctum is yours.

Ancient Mega Pack

Skip Helsik's ritual? The ingredients land in your bags and the portal to the House of Hope opens at the Devil's Fee.

Ancient Mega Pack

Consider Dribbles found? The scavenger hunt ends, and Lucretious pays out as if you brought her every last piece.

Ancient Mega Pack

This story is already settled. There is nothing left to resolve.

Ancient Mega Pack

This story cannot be reached from here. Travel to its region first.
Quick Resolve: Skip Lockpicking

[Non-legit while enabled]

Toggle. While active, any locked chest, door or container is unlocked and opened the instant you try to pick, open or bash it, no minigame needed. Works in every act. Use it again to turn locks back on.

Ancient Mega Pack

Skip lockpicking from now on? While active, any lock springs open the moment you try to pick, open or force it, in every act.

Ancient Mega Pack

Turn automatic unlocking back off? Locks will need picking again.
Quick Resolve: End of Act One

[Non-legit]

Fold the whole first act into one chosen ending. Every side quest closes, the grove is either saved or sacked, the wilderness is cleared of enemies along with their loot, and the party is paid the experience of a full run. This cannot be undone.

Ancient Mega Pack

Settle the whole of Act One right now? Quests close, the wilderness empties, and none of it can be taken back. Continue?

Ancient Mega Pack

Save the grove? The goblin leaders fall, the refugees survive and leave for Baldur's Gate, and their story carries on into the acts to come.

Ancient Mega Pack

Then sack the grove alongside the raiders? The refugees and the druids die, Halsin is lost, and companions who object may leave the party for good.

Ancient Mega Pack

Should Halsin be waiting at camp afterwards?

Ancient Mega Pack

Should Kagha be spared? Refuse and she dies with the shadow druids.

Ancient Mega Pack

Clear the wilderness? Every hostile group dies where it stands and drops its loot. Civilians, children and folk the quests still need are left alone.

Ancient Mega Pack

Put the haul straight into your bags? Coins, shards, forge moulds, gear and gold in the amounts a cleared act pays out.

Ancient Mega Pack

Bring the party up to the level a full run ends on? Nobody is levelled down.

Ancient Mega Pack

The grove is in the middle of its own events right now. Settle them, or wait for them to end, and try again.

Ancient Mega Pack

The act is being wound up. Give it a few moments: the journal, the wilderness and the rewards settle in turn.
